name: Taigenchi: The Eternal Eclipse
source:
You are in a world where anyone can have supernatural abilities. You're friend Mike invited you, and the rest of your friend group to stay at his house for a while. You try and live the most normal life you possibly can and bring happiness to you and your friends, however, nothing seems to be going right.

Even with all the magic, power, and influence you may have, something's never change.

All you want is to make your friends happy.



"I feel as though I'm a human in a canine's body.

I don't have habits that a canine should. I have half the instincts that a normally would.

I can't truly judge since I can never truly understand them.

Who am I? What am I?

I don't belong in this body.

"I don't think like a canine. I think like a human.

....Something's Never Change."

[From [url=https://tendomendo.itch.io/eternal-eclipse]Itch.io[/url]]
